title: Presentation of the fppf quotient of a group scheme by a specified kernel
statement: Let $B$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $N,G,Q$ be group objects in schemes over $B$ (the relative form of [def-sc-group-scheme]), with group homomorphisms $i:N\to G$ and $q:G\to Q$. Use fibre products as in [def-pc-fibre-product] and the big fppf site of $B$ [def-pc-fppf-site]. A presentation of $Q$ as the fppf group quotient of $G$ by the specified kernel $i$ means the following conjunction. The square with top map $i$, left map $N\to B$, right map $q$, and bottom map the unit $e_Q:B\to Q$ is cartesian. The represented map $h_q:h_G\to h_Q$ is locally surjective for the fppf topology, and $h_Q$ is an fppf sheaf. There is an isomorphism $G\times_BN\simeq G\times_QG$ whose two projections are $(g,n)\mapsto g$ and $(g,n)\mapsto g\,i(n)$. Let $C$ be the coequalizer, in presheaves of sets on schemes over $B$, of the maps $h_{G\times_BN}\rightrightarrows h_G$ induced by those same projection and multiplication maps; thus $C$ is the pointwise right-coset presheaf. There exists $\eta_q:C\to h_Q$ whose composite with the coequalizer projection is $h_q$, such that for every fppf sheaf of sets $Z$, precomposition with $\eta_q$ is a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(h_Q,Z)\to\operatorname{Hom}(C,Z)$. This last condition is the sheafification universal property [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. All test schemes and values use the common size universe of the group schemes. No affineness, finite-type, smoothness or field-base condition is part of this definition.
